name: Izhar
title: Son of Kohath and Levitical ancestor
summary: Izhar was a son of Kohath, grandson of Levi, and thus an important figure in the lineage of the Levites. He was the father of Korah, Nepheg, and Zicri, and his descendants, the Izharites, had specific duties related to the tabernacle service. Through his son Korah, he is also known in connection with Korah's rebellion against Moses and Aaron.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Levi
keyEvents.description: Izhar is listed as one of Kohath's four sons in the tribe of Levi, an important lineage for Levitical service.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Izhar Are Mentioned
keyEvents.description: Izhar's sons Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri are mentioned in the genealogy in Exodus.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy of the Kohathites in Numbers
keyEvents.description: In the census of the Levites, Izhar is mentioned as part of Kohath's lineage with specific service duties.

keyEvents.title: Duties of the Izharites in David's Time
keyEvents.description: During King David's reign, the Izharites, descendants of Izhar, were assigned specific administrative and spiritual tasks, including serving as officials and judges.

keyEvents.title: Korah's Rebellion – Consequence for Izhar's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Izhar's son Korah led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron, resulting in the earth opening up and swallowing the rebels. This is one of the most dramatic events associated with Izhar's descendants.

keyEvents.title: The Izharites in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Izhar is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the son of Kohath in the detailed review of the Levitical lineages and service.
